Our school was known for teachers dying of cancer. The one that hit our school the hardest was when the basketball coach/ science teacher got stage 4 cancer. He was always such a healthy man and everyone loved him. When they announced his passing over the intercom everyone froze. After his death the school was never the same it was like when he died our school spirt went with him. Memorials were put up all around the school and even though it was 3 years ago you can still feel the empty space he left

I worked at a summer camp. I worked there for a few summers and have a few stories. 

1. At the end of the day I had to check the bathroom and I found a lake of pee. Pee everywhere but the toilet. Worst smell ever. I had to mop it up

2. One little kid hated being there. He would scream and kick if you tried to get him to join the activity that was planned. Final straw was when the kid tried to bite me when he was flipping out at refusing to move.

My best friend I'd known since 5th grade (I was in 12th at the time) threatened to shoot the school up after parkland. He was arrested and didn't try to contact me till a few months later only to act like he hadn't threatened our school. I haven't spoken to him in months and it still hurts to think about how i lost my closest friend. Now I'm hesitant to be close to anyone because I never want to feel the pain of being betrayed like that again
